details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: integer overflow when compiling crafted regexps
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-110264.patch: reject overflowed range-repeat
       and null-check IDs in huge regexps
     - CVE-2026-110264
   * SECURITY UPDATE: integer overflow when compiling crafted regexps
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-93577-CVE-2026-97229.patch: avoid overflow in
       the quantifier expansion size check and reject a compiled program too
       big for its offset type
     - CVE-2026-93577
     - CVE-2026-97229
   * Fix build-time test failures:
     - debian/patches/fix-timezone-tests-and-update-expired-certs.patch:
       replace the expired test certificates and follow the installed
       tzdata in the Asia/Singapore checks
     - debian/patches/fix-eaddrinuse-race-in-port0-tests.patch: avoid
       EADDRINUSE races in tests that listen on a random port
     - debian/tests/excludes: skip the DTrace probe tests and two
       permission tests, which fail when the test suite runs as root
